subject_description: the impact of a heavy basalt boss meteor into a copper ember ellipse on the ground
initial_pose: quiet sparse copper warning rim centered at x64 y65 on the ground, empty center
description: A heavy meteor strikes the EXACT CENTER of this ground ellipse. At the start, a short powerful burst of three chunky orange fire tongues rises upward from its center with a few angular dark stone chips kicking sideways. A brief pale amber accent only at the tiny impact point, never a white disk. The broken copper rim shudders once. Fire immediately collapses downward into a low dark scorched patch and a few dim embers. The embers and scorch then dissipate entirely to fully transparent by the final frame. Ground contact stays FIXED at the original ellipse center, camera fixed, no panning or growth of canvas, all fire inside margins. Coarse crisp flat pixel-art clusters, charcoal/rust/copper/amber, no smooth smoke, no white flash, no giant radial ring, no text.
